verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles computes traits on profiles: entities and attributes are declared in YAML, and warehouse-native SQL handles feature aggregation (rudderstack-docs-35, rudderstack-docs-60, rudderstack-docs-31). Separately, Audiences can be built on warehouse sources and synced downstream (rudderstack-docs-27, rudderstack-docs-6). The evidence never mentions predictive scores such as LTV, churn or propensity, and the trait definition workflow is YAML/code-driven rather than marketer-friendly. Missing for 10: predictive/ML scores (LTV, churn, purchase propensity), explicit documentation that computed traits feed audience targeting, a marketer-facing UI for defining traits, independent corroboration.
